subject.title: fix: use atomic writes for crash-safety on exec approvals, restart sentinel, shell profile, and saveJsonFile

question: Should maintainers sponsor the remaining shell-profile atomic-write hardening now, despite the current no-new-fix-pr routing?
rationale: The remaining defect is narrow and source-reproducible, but it edits user shell startup files and the issue is explicitly labeled for maintainer review rather than a new automated fix PR.

options.title: Sponsor narrow profile-write fix
options.body: Use the existing atomic text writer for profile creation and update, preserve current profile resolution and permissions, and leave fixed persistence paths untouched.

options.title: Keep in maintainer backlog
options.body: Leave the issue open until a maintainer wants to own shell-profile setup hardening and review the permission/symlink behavior directly.

options.title: Close as accepted risk
options.body: Close only if maintainers intentionally accept direct shell-profile rewrites despite the source-reproducible truncation risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow profile-write fix
recommendation.body: Use the existing atomic text writer for profile creation and update, preserve current profile resolution and permissions, and leave fixed persistence paths untouched.
